summary:
Senior Infrastructure and Information Security Leader with 16+ years’ expertise in enterprise vulnerability management,
regulatory compliance, IT operations resilience, audit automation, and predictive security. Proven record as primary CXO-
level liaison for RBI and ISO audits, ISMS governance, and strategic vendor management. Holds an MBA in IT Operations
and certifications including AWS Certified Security – Specialty (SCS-C02) and Certified Information Security Manager
(CISM). Proficient in cloud security architecture, governance, risk management, and aligning security strategies with
business objectives to strengthen cyber resilience and compliance maturity across hybrid and cloud environments.

pre_date_header: Sr Manager - Infrastructure, Enterprise Security & Cybersecurity
bullets: Equifax Inc. is a leading financial services provider in India, delivering credit reports and scores to banks, BFSI institutions, and MFIs, operating under the regulatory framework of the Reserve Bank of India.
Enterprise Security & Vulnerability Management
Directed enterprise-wide Vulnerability Management Program across Windows, Linux, Unix, databases, on-prem data centers, and cloud platforms.
Implemented risk-based remediation frameworks leveraging predictive analytics, reducing false positives by 15% and improving patch SLA compliance by 10%.
Established automated patch orchestration and compliance tracking, increasing deployment success rate by 15%.
Security Operations Center (SOC) & Threat Management
Built and matured 24x7 SOC operations, enabling real-time threat detection, incident response, and threat hunting.

Led implementation of SIEM & SOAR platforms including Splunk Enterprise Security, IBM QRadar, Microsoft Sentinel, ArcSight, LogRhythm, Palo Alto Cortex XSOAR, and Splunk SOAR to automate incident response and improve SOC efficiency.
Cloud Security & Governance (AWS)
Architected and governed enterprise cloud security framework on AWS, implementing services such as AWS Security Hub, GuardDuty, WAF, Shield, IAM, CloudWatch, and AWS Config.
Ensured secure cloud adoption aligned with Zero Trust principles, CIS benchmarks, and regulatory requirements.
Data Center & Infrastructure Leadership
Led design and operations of highly available, fully redundant Tier III/IV data centers, supporting IaaS and PaaS environments with 24x7 uptime.
Delivered Disaster Recovery (DR) and Business Continuity Planning (BCP) strategies ensuring minimal downtime and operational resilience.
Drove capacity planning, performance optimization, and operational insights, improving infrastructure efficiency by 15%.
Regulatory Compliance & ISMS Governance
Served as Primary SPOC for RBI and ISO/IEC 27001:2022 audits, managing end-to-end audit lifecycle including governance, risk assessment, evidence management, and remediation.
Architected and governed Information Security Management System (ISMS), defining policies, controls, and enterprise security frameworks.
Compliance automation, reducing audit response time by 20%.
IT Strategy, Financial Planning & Vendor Management
Defined and executed enterprise IT infrastructure strategy and roadmap, aligning with business goals.
Managed IT budgeting, cost optimization, and financial planning, ensuring ROI-driven investments.
Led vendor governance, OEM partnerships, and techno-commercial negotiations, ensuring alignment with cybersecurity and infrastructure strategy.
Enterprise IT Operations & Workplace Services
Managed end-user computing, workplace services, and unified communication (UC) infrastructure, including AV systems.
Oversaw enterprise data platforms and analytics ecosystems such as Azure Synapse, AWS Redshift, and Google BigQuery
